sources.title: Qwen3.5-Omni Technical Report - arXiv.org
sources.snippet: Abstract In this work, we present Qwen3.5-Omni, the latest advancement in the Qwen-Omni model family. Representing a significant evolution over its predecessor, Qwen3.5-Omni scales to hundreds of billions of parameters and supports a 256k context length.
